To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed novel approaches for the improvement of THz sources based on DFG in mid infrared QCLs and demonstrated the first narrow linewidth free running continuous wave DFG THz QCL.

we have experimentally demonstrated a novel approach to increase the THz tuning bandwidth of DFG QCL sources by optimizing the optical rectification terms, we have developed a new DFG QCL on silicon platform that significantly improves the out coupling efficiency of THz radiation, and we have reported for the first time a THz DFG source with a narrow linewidth.
we have demonstrated a THz DFG device with the optimized optical nonlinearities and improved out coupling efficiency.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of high power, high tuning bandwidth and low linewidth THz sources based on DFG QCL devices.
the development of novel THz QCLs and THz sources with improved tuning bandwidths and output powers.
the development of high power, narrow linewidth, ultra broadband THz DFG sources that will enable a wide variety of applications ranging from spectroscopy and imaging to communications and security.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the THz emission from DFG QCL can be improved by more than an order of magnitude by using a double Litt row external cavity system, and that the THz DFG can be extended to the 1.5-2.5 THz range using a hybrid DFG device on silicon.
we have demonstrated a novel approach to improve THz output power and bandwidth of THz sources based on DFG QCL devices.
we have developed a new class of ultra broadband THz sources with narrow linewidths based on DFG in mid infrared QCLs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the THz DFG in QCLs is a powerful approach to generate THz radiation in a broad wavelength range and high output power.
we have demonstrated that THz sources based on DFG in mid infrared QCLs are capable of generating narrow linewidth ultra broadband THz radiation.
THz generation in mid infrared QCLs is a promising approach to generate THz radiation with a high output power and a narrow linewidth.
The main takeaway from our work is that
THz DFG in QCLs has great potential for applications requiring narrow linewidth, high power, and ultra broadband THz sources.
THz DFG in QCLs can be used to generate narrow linewidth THz sources with ultra broad tuning bandwidth and high power output.
the DFG QCL is a promising candidate for a compact and robust THz source for applications in spectroscopy and imaging.
